title: Best Giant Lego Set (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on the products mentioned in the provided sources, prioritizing those referenced by more than one source and with the largest piece counts.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a fan who loves Star Wars and wants a large, detailed model. The X‑Wing set offers 42 times fewer pieces than the world‑record 5,335,200‑piece model, making it a realistic build for collectors. It wins because it is the only set in this guide that is a licensed Star Wars model and the largest in terms of piece count among the picks.
